n1.speaker: npc_pell
n1.text: Two now. Same hand, same ink. And look: the originals vanish from shelf six on the nights of the raids.

n2.speaker: npc_pell
n2.text: Something comes up out of the Gate on those nights. It is not looking for clerks. It is looking for files.

n3.speaker: npc_pell
n3.text: Talk to the demon at the Gate. Quill. He keeps honest books, for a demon. At night, when the Watch is busy.
